tasks./opt/walker/manipulation_meta_tasks/shar:
meta_name: MetaClamp
#hqp_params
var_damping:
  [99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99]
right_hand: [1, 1, 1, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3]
left_hand: [1, 1, 1, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3]
torso: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
com_constrain: []
# com: [0, 0, 0]
left_hand_manipulability: [0.001]
right_hand_manipulability: [0.001]
#task_request
request:
  duration: 12.0
  frequency: 500
  urdf_name: "cruzr_s2"
  biped_quit: true
  collision_detect: true
  collision_data:
    - body_name: "left_hand"
      data:
        - time: [10.0, 10.0, 12.0] #记录力时间，开始检测碰撞时间，结束检测碰撞时间
          collision_force: [0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    - body_name: "right_hand"
      data:
        - time: [10.0, 10.0, 12.0] #记录力时间，开始检测碰撞时间，结束检测碰撞时间
          collision_force: [0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
  box_size: [0.6, 0.4, 0.28]
  position_rotation_limit_data:
    - position_rotation_limit_low: [0.2, -0.1, -0.1, -0.5, -0.5, -0.4]
      position_rotation_limit_up: [0.2, -0.1, -0.1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.4]

  component_disable_time:
    - [0.0, 0.0]
  task_type: "clamp_box"
  task_stack: task_stack_cruzr_clamp_manipulability.yaml
  robot_trajectory_data:
    - body_name: "left_hand"
      data:
        - timestamp: 6.0
          position: [0.75, 0.285, 1.10] # x y z
          orientation: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "ABSOLUTE"
        - timestamp: 10.0
          position: [0.20, 0.0, 0.0] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "RELATIVE"
        - timestamp: 12.0
          position: [0.0, 0.0, -0.20] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "RELATIVE"
    - body_name: "right_hand"
      data:
        - timestamp: 6.0
          position: [0.75, -0.285, 1.10] # x y z
          orientation: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "ABSOLUTE"
        - timestamp: 10.0
          position: [0.20, 0.0, 0.0] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "RELATIVE"
        - timestamp: 12.0
          position: [0.0, 0.0, -0.20] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "RELATIVE"
    - body_name: "torso"
      data:
        - timestamp: 6.0
          position: [0.0, 0.0, 1.2] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "ABSOLUTE"
        - timestamp: 10.0
          position: [0.30, 0, 1.2] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "ABSOLUTE"
        - timestamp: 12.0
          position: [0.0, 0.0, -0.20] # x y z
          orientation: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # w x y z
          tranform_mode: "RELATIVE"
  admit_param:
    enable_admit: true
    use_first_as_init_force: false
    use_base_coordinate: base #base, body or hand
    use_fence_force: true
    select_series: time_series # time_series or traj_series
    avg_filt_times: 100
    Init_left_force_sensor_point: [6]
    Init_right_force_sensor_point: [6]
    left_admit_enable_time_series: #vector. use in time_series
      - [6.0, 12.0]
    right_admit_enable_time_series: #vector. use in time_series
      - [6.0, 12.0]
    left_force_mask: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]
    # pos:0  imped:1  pimped:2  fimped:3
    right_force_mask: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]
    # pos:0  imped:1  pimped:2  fimped:3
    left_desire_force: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [1.0, 20.0, 3.0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]
    right_desire_force: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [1.0, -20.0, 3.0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]

    vel_limit: [0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3] #x y z r p y  单位：m/s rad/s
    ft_dz_set: [1, 1, 1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1] #x y z r p y     单位：N Nm

    k_fence: [1000, 1000, 1000]
    fence_radius: [1.3, 0.37, 1]
    center_point: [0, 0, 0] #base
    fence_force_threshold: [45, 45, 45]

    ImpedanceParam: # m b k
      [
        [5, 750, 200], #x y z r p y
        [5, 750, 200],
        [5, 750, 200],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
      ]
    forceTrackingParam: # kp ki kd
      [
        [0.1, 1, 0.01], #x y z r p y
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
      ]

  dual_admit_param:
    enable_admit: false
    avg_filt_times: 100
    select_series: time_series # traj_series or time_series
    Init_force_sensor_point: [8]
    admit_enable_time_series: #vector. use in time_series
      - [8.0, 10.0]
    ext_force_mask: [[0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]] #x y z r p y
    int_force_mask: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]
    ext_desire_force: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]
    int_desire_force: #must as long as arm pointlist
      [
        [1.0, -40.0, 10.0, 0, 0, 0], #x y z r p y
      ]

    vel_limit: [0.1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1] #x y z r p y  单位：m/s rad/s
    ext_ft_dz_set: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05] #x y z r p y     单位：N Nm
    int_ft_dz_set: [1, 1, 1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05] #x y z r p y     单位：N Nm

    ExtImpedanceParam: # m b k
      [
        [5, 150, 0], #x y z r p y
        [5, 150, 0],
        [5, 150, 0],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
      ]
    ExtForceTrackingParam: # kp ki kd
      [
        [0.1, 1, 0.01], #x y z r p y
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
      ]
    IntImpedanceParam: # m b k
      [
        [5, 750, 100], #x y z r p y
        [5, 750, 100],
        [5, 750, 100],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
        [0.08, 1.2, 5],
      ]
    IntForceTrackingParam: # kp ki kd
      [
        [0.1, 1, 0.01], #x y z r p y
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],

        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
        [0.1, 1, 0.01],
      ]
